If you've never been to an IKEA and you need some inspiration to spruce up that extra bedroom or just something spicy to add to your home definitely check this store out. As you walk around the store in IKEA, you're able to see how the decor and appliances will look in a real  context. Everything from demo kitchens to bedrooms and bathrooms. Write down the item number or take a picture of what you like and then go into the warehouse and pick it up. The prices are very reasonable (some items such as the wooden cutting boards are a steal!) and have a wide variety of price ranges and styles. They do have a cafeteria there (I did not dine there) but it seemed it be clean and probably was decent food. This IKEA is only one story and not as big as some others but there definitely was a lot to see and a good way to spend an hour or two.

Don't ever expect prompt service from the furniture pick up section. They told me my order would be brought out in 10 minutes, I regret to inform you that over an hour later I'm still standing here with no order and no explanation with no employee caring about my requests. If this were a Saturday maybe it's excusable, but it's 1130 on a Tuesday. Horrible service, I won't be back and you shouldn't come.

This place is huge. We did the walk through and that was fun however this store is so overwhelming and I feel that the items are not good quality for a grown up. It's definitely something that everyone should experience though!!!

Swedish dishes? From salmon to meatballs to chicken tenders! Desserts? From ice cream for a dollar to cinnamon buns and Loganberry drinks! 
You can literally spend all day in IKEA. This specific location is my go to since it's closer to where I'm located. 
The design and layout is very easy to follow, the different departments are easy to locate when you're in a hurry to find what you're looking for. 
Be sure to use your cellphones to take photos of the item that you want because IKEA is always laid out in a way where the inventory is on the lower level and you have to find it yourself!

Please do not subject yourself to this awful consumer experience, horrendous customer service, terrible product installation, poor quality assurance, and a total disregard for customers' time and money. I will not go further into detail because I simply do not have any more energy to lend to this scam of business. However, I feel it totally necessary to warn anyone that is contemplating using IKEA for anything other than a plant, to please reconsider. Just try to call their customer service line and it will verify what a complete joke this company truly is. I'll save you an hour because that's about how long you will have to await an actual person to help you, IF you don't get disconnected half way through. Go to Home Depot or Lowes. In fact, run!

Although I love the candles and meatballs I'm just not a fan of this location. Not nearly as nice as Ohio. 

Came in for a free meal. I received a coupon in my email and you gotta use coupons. Got meatball meal and cake for free. Cake was tasteless. Meatballs and mashed potatoes were great. Soda fountain is the worst. It kept spitting out lots of C02 and the soda tasted like Big k kola. Also had a coupon for 15$ off so got 10 candles for $5.24. 

New displays and empty displays guessing waiting on new product. Up by the check out lanes they had too many displays of summer stuff. It looks and feels very cramped. 

Two lanes open to check out today that was ok they weren't at all busy.

Wish we were closer to the Columbus Ohio store. It is soo much nicer.

Came here over the weekend to do some shopping, didn't buy any furniture buy did buy a lot of in home stuff. Prices were the same as San Francisco/Oakland's Ikea which was a little shocking to be considering the cost of living difference between the cities...

I actually worked at Ikea for a month before I quit because management seemed to refuse to hire more employees (and I was making 3x as much driving Uber/Lyft). I worked in the As-Is department that was smaller than the As-Is department here but I feel like we had way more stuff than what was here. I'm assuming long lines at the exit and restaurant means not enough employees which probably means not enough people processing all the returns and turning them into As-Is items.

I absolutely love the ease of everything and the selection that they have. My husband and I arrived 10 minutes before closing and we are ready to purchase nearly an $800 table and I asked an employee if we could grab it quickly and she said if you can do it within the next three minutes. We walked out and got a table almost double the cost elsewhere. I had told the employee that the hours online said they were open for another hour just to let them know in case other people came in with the same problem and she completely ignored me.

Long story short......if you find an item that's on sale and you are making a special trip for it, make sure to verify it's in stock.  

A couple different employees told me they usually run out of sale items very quickly and it's first come first serve and they don't offer you a raincheck on the sale price.  Sounds like a gimmick to me.  Run a sale and have a couple items in stock to draw customers in then run out and you still have the customers in the store to buy other items at full price.

Most other companies would offer you a raincheck on the sale item, but not IKEA.  Too bad that we wasted 4 hours of your time for nothing, but there's nothing we can do for you.

I like the selections at IKEA and I really like the coupons that are provided for being an IKEA family member. Their food in the cafeteria is really good too lol. I hope they're store expands to the Delaware area sooner or later.
I love the look of the store like I brought a black bed for the game but it's cool tho
Try calling their customer service no 888-888-4532.  It rings no where.  How can a large chain get by with this??

AAAAAAAAAAHHH! I bought a couch set Saturday night. Paid $30 to have it delivered Wednesday. I took the day off of work. Not only were the couches NOT DELIVERED, but IKEA CUSTOMER SERVICE HAD ME ON HOLD FOR OVER 40 MINUTES three seperate times without resolving any of it. Then I could not get through to a person!!!!! I am sitting here with the day gone, no couches and nobody answereing a phone to tell me where the couches are.

All around poor customer service today. I've always been satisfied with this IKEA, but this trip wasn't as pleasant. 

The woman in the cafeteria was not helpful when I said I didn't have my IKEA Family card. She was rude about it and offered no assistance. 

The woman at checkout was just as rude. As she was scanning my items she looked at me and said, "you need to move your stuff so I can scan it." As I'm standing there arms full, a shopping cart and push cart packed with goods. No "thank you," "have a nice day," etc. 

Can't beat a tray of food for less than $7. 

IKEA excels at many things, customer service just isn't one of them.

Take this review as you wish, I am a native Swede and might just be somewhat partial :)
IKEA was part of my life growing up and I am so happy to have a store in my hometown here in America!
Eating at IKEA is like going home for a short time, for me.
That said, I think this is a great, casual dining option. Food is good and very reasonably priced.
A given for any first time visitors is the Swedish meatballs with mashed potatoes and sauce. Do not pass on the lingonberries. They compliment the meat so perfectly!
Other great dishes are the salmon and the stuffed chicken breast.
The salmon is light and cooked just right. The Sauce has a slight lemon flavor that compliments both the fish and the vegetables nicely.
The chicken is a generous portion. The crust is nice and crisp and the filling is gooey and satisfying.
The selection of sweets is a perfect end to a great meal. The princess cake is light and fluffy. The marzipan topping is sweet and delicious.
The Daim cake is perfect for the chocolate lover. 
Enjoy a great meal in a family friendly and wallet friendly restaurant!
This is a single floor Ikea which feels a little smaller with less items than both Chicago and West Chester, OH

HORRIBLE CUSTOMER SERVICE!!!!!
I purchased my entire kitchen to be delivered on 3/24..it is now 5/3 and do not have all the correct pieces to my kitchen. You can leave as many messages as you want and they will never call you back, when I finally travel the 90 miles to the Fishers IN store to speak to someone they think a $50 gift card will fix everything. The biggest mistake EVER, was to buy a kitchen from IKEA.

Be prepared to spend hours here. There's so much to take in and it's all so aesthetically it pleasing! I had my first IKEA experience at this brand-new store and LOVED it! Warning: You'll want to buy everything in the store! (And that's not really a bad thing because it's all relatively inexpensive). On a weekday, it was not crowded at all, but I hear on the weekends it's hectic. The employees were friendly and super helpful. After walking around for a little over an hour around lunchtime, I was hungry and a bit exhausted. The restaurant was the best pick-me-up! The food is sooo reasonably priced, healthy, and fresh! No complaints :)

Every once in awhile I'll get the itch to go to Ikea especially since we started doing a bunch of projects are our house. I have always loved the displays rooms they have set up and it can definitely provide ideas on what you would like or how to incorporate certain things into a particular room. 

The store is a pretty decent size so you always have to give yourself some time when coming here. The plus side they have almost everything you need for a house and prices are pretty decent. The only down size especially with smaller items is if you see it in the display room, you may have to look for it throughout the store. Bigger items they have aisle & bin associated with them so you can pick it up before you check out.

They do have a clearance section which some of their display items will go there or things with minor scratches, I would say make sure to check this out. Especially if you're a DIYer, you might have some good finds. 

Also, did I mention that their food is actually pretty good?! And they have a child play area as well.
Love going here! Bought a another bedroom set. Very great products and easy instructions to follow
employees are so kind and helpful. so willing to help lift and find things. love going there even though it's busy!

DO NOT WASTE YOUR TIME GOING TO THIS STORE!  Two weeks ago went to buy sofa.  Chose a sofa went to get all of the pieces with the clerk, got to last component, was told it wasn't in stock. She went to the manager so that we could order the sofa and have delivered. Was told I could not order until all pieces were available which would be in two days. Went back to store....went through the whole process again, then found out all components again not in stock!!!! (online it stated the pieces were all in stock at this store 19148). Decided to order another sofa online and have delivered.  It was delivered today and it included the wrong screws. Went in person to 19148 store they gave me new screws, got home and they are wrong AGAIN!  I have been on hold for 40 minutes with the store...DO NOT, I repeat DO NOT, go to IKEA!  I will be disputing the charge on my credit card and I will NEVER shop there again.  BTW I am still on hold......talk about BAD customer service, this is appalling.

I'm completely surrounded by IKEA furniture in my house, oh the horror! How dare they save me so much money while giving me solid, study furniture! 

I am a huge IKEA fan, and even though the lines and instructions are terrible, the quality for the price is worth it.
We came to look at furniture, but checked out the restaurant first. The smoked salmon was great! Great price, too.

I Love Ikea!!  Every time I went to an Ikea in other states I went on their computer to say that Indianapolis, Carmel or Fishers Indiana would be a great market for them.  I'm glad to see they chose to come to Fishers, IN.  They appear to be doing very well.  They're always busy.  They deserve your business.

First visit to IKEA. EVER! Who has never been to IKEA, you say? *raises hand* *face palm*

I visited this iconic store recently not really prepared for what to expect. I knew the place was big, but my goodness! How many sections of stuff can there be to choose from?!?! IKEA has it covered. Walking through the store, I literally felt I was in a corn maze. Literally. There were maps above my head with directions on where to go to find whatever I needed. There are actually SHORTCUTS through the displays!! Seriously!!! If you want to avoid going around the whole store, you can cut through doors to go directly to what you're looking for.
Shout out to the architects for this place because....whew.

While I enjoyed finally getting acclimated, I can say I wasn't overly impressed with the quality. Yes, this is boxed, DIY furniture. Yes, it totally looks like it. This is nowhere to be if you're looking for something rich and hearty for your home. I felt like most of it is paint by number, connect the dots-ish.

All in all, it's fun to go visit and be a part of the "rush", but for me it's just ok. But - that's ok! Check it out for yourself!

IKEA entire customer service is systematically failing. Average wait time for a call is over 70min. I requested refund to my original payment of credit card, but they sent me a gift card which I don't eang

In my opinion any IKEA is just a fantastic day trip. I am beyond bursting at the seams with excitement as I come to this new built about 6 months ago. It is a little different than the plethora of other ones I have been to but doesn't that just lead up to the excitement?  Why, yes it does people!!  
Pretty easy to get to off 69. During the time and day I went there wasn't any traffic, and I got there right when it opened. So I noticed, as all of them are, what a gargantuan place this is. Then I noticed it was all one level!!  What???  How is this possible?  But it is. And it was kinda nice to Shop this was vs the two or Three level ones I've been to elsewhere.  Walking in you will notice how clean it is. Staff isn't to friendly. Hit or miss with that.  Super knowledgeable when you have questions at least so that is a bonus. 
The cafeteria isn't as big as the others and neither is the bistro as you walk in but that's ok they still have the same cheap great food with a few new desserts!  Free coffee for members while you shop so grab it early at the bistro and refill at the cafeteria. 
Restrooms were super Uber clean. Offered two handicapped bathroom stalls. That's awesome. And they have a separate baby room you can take your whole family and garb into if you caMe loaded up with strollers etc. checking out is smooth but prepare for a line, 2-3 lanes open at any given time. But this is all part of the experience people!!  
Still a lot of merch offered and prices seemed a tad higher than other locations but maybe I was just assuming that. 
All in all we spent about 5 Hours in this store. Which is great considering I've spent longer in other locations. 
Can't wait to go again. It's so close it just may have to be an every other month outing.

If I could give less stars I would. The customer service is terrible - god forbid you have a problem and need help from them. They are pretty impossible to get a hold of. We ordered a dining room table and it was delivered to us broken - I sent an email with the details of this and no reply (this is over 2 weeks later). Tried calling, no help whatsoever. Every time I call I'm put on hold with a minimum wait time of 45-55minutes! Even then they don't answer. Really not impressed. If you want good quality and customer service go elsewhere!!!

UPDATE:  65 in stock, but THREE IKEA associates couldn't find one.  How bad is your inventory system when you can't find 65 of something?  Some people drive hundreds of miles to go to IKEA, I can't imagine driving hours to buy something because your website says there's 65 in stock only to find I wasted my time. 


OLD REVIEW:  they might as well shutdown small land if they're never going to have enough help to watch the kids that are being brought there.  Every time I've come they have a few kids there but claim a 1 hour wait.  Why have a daycare that never has open spaces?

A legitimate wonderland of home 'needs'.  I walked in intending to spend nothing and walked out with $80 gone from my bank account. Everything you need and don't need...then suddenly need around the house. 


  The cafeteria food was horrendous, by the way.  Can't wait to go back, though.

I've never been to an ikea I haven't loved and this one was no exception. The one inconvenience is that if you want to just stop by the cafe you have to walk through half of the entire building to get there. I'm sure this is done on purpose because every time I have to cut through it I find stuff I just can't live with out. Staff are awesome!

After placing an order for $1400.00 I wanted to make a minor change regarding a $69.00 side table. The "white" finish was not the one I intended to purchase. I want the "stained white" finish. However, when calling customer service to make this change, I am told there is a 96 minute wait! This is not acceptable to me as i sit here awaiting a response while the Ikea audio repeats & repeats. Blah blah. Customer Service = F-  !

Honestly, I come for the meatballs and stay for the maze of furniture, art, and knick knacks. The food is amazing and worth the drive alone! 

The picture frames are cheap and great. They're great for teachers to frame all of our certificates or cute letters from students.
Doesn't matter which IKEA ...parking is always ridiculous ...kids love the chicken strips here and dollar yogart
There coffee machine and cappuccino is to die for! Oh! And have I mentioned it's free for IKEA family members? Delicious

I am really just giving five stars for the cafe. The furniture here is a big rip off and poor quality. I love to come here for coffee and eats, though. The prices can't be beat and the big windows in the dining area are nice. I love this place.

I love Ikea it's just a super fun place to go. It's like an adventure in a store plus you can eat there.... food is always great the veggie meatballs are wonderful and of course the chocolate cake. For a retail store it's always a great experience. Great set up easy to spend time in the store. I recommended to go during the week it's less busy.

In the past I had to do road trips to Cindy or Chicago for IKEA. Now loving that we have an option near Indy.. and before they did a construction freeze this year. There are so many fun little home furnishings, plants, have you had their little oatmeal cookies?! Delicious!! I've brought them to parties before and it's always a hit.

Now if only there wasn't so much traffic on I-69 getting there, I wouldn't hesitate for a 5. :)

Amazing food as always! Never disappoints! Their Swedish meatballs are amazing but I tried a salad that had cranberries and I'm not sure what else... but it was absolutely heavenly! I literally dreamed about it that night. I highly suggest it! Their raspberry-pink-circular dessert though? Yeah, skip that. That stuff is nasty.

We bought a bedroom and paid for IKEA to assemble it-they charge a very expensive fee. They arrived to our home with one of the parts missing and have been telling us that they will return and put it together yet have not done so. My wife had to wait more than an hour on the line with them to only get false promise after another. Very disappointing. We will never bug anything from there. Not worth the savings.

I had my very first experience at IKEA the other day. And let me tell you, this place is like a museum!! There is sooo much to look at and the set up is amazing! I love how the furniture and decor is organized into rooms. Definitely draws you in and makes it a lot more appealing. They even have a food court to take a break and eat after all the walking haha. The reason I gave it four stars was because of the checkout area. The customers are responsible to pick the items up from the warehouse. Unless ordered for pickup. The furniture can be heavy depending on what you get. I will say the stand that I got was super easy to put together! The instructions were thoroughly made, and all the pieces came attached. All around a fun place to be in.

I love IKEA and have furnished three houses with their stuff because I love it. Every time I move, I sell my stuff and buy the newest furniture at IKEA. Now, the reason my review is not five stars is because this past weekend I went to get a tv center table and a bedroom set and they were out of stock of the center table and the two night stands. I can't believe a store as big as IKEA runs out of stock and can't bring more merchandise until July, so it takes them a month to replenish stock on their most sold items? Unbelievable. So I called this morning because the website was showing 4 nightstands online and the nice customer service lady told me that the Tampa store received stock yesterday but they won't put it out on the floor until the first week of July! What kind of business are they running at this location?. I'm wondering if that's an IKEA rule or just this store that they hold onto the most sell items and only put them out once a month even tho there a tons of customers waiting for it. Based on my most recent experience my IKEA standards went from 5 stars to 3 stars, management has to do something because they are starting to sound like any other furniture store with their out of stock, we will deliver in a month, promises.

I love the IKEA store but forgot a few things while I was there, so I decided to order them online on April 24. I waited two weeks before calling, then waited 45 minutes on the phone to speak with somebody and they told me it takes 2 to 3 weeks to get my merchandise. On May 17 I called again and waited 40 minutes to speak with a human and they said they didn't know what happened but they would give me a refund Within two weeks. It is now June 11 and I still have not received the refund. I'm tired of wasting my time on the phone waiting for them. So next time I will just go to the store and never order anything online from them again.

This place can have all my money. Every dime. There's not much to say other than, how perfect can one store get? They have plants, dish ware, couches, whole kitchens! I could spend hours in there buying things I don't need because it's so cheap. 

The 365 return policy hassle free is wonderful too. Makes me forget all about my $99 3-drawer malm dresser that I had to look for three times before it was in stock and I literally got the last one. It also broke the day after I put it together, so there's that. But...I can return it! 

The food is soooo good. Swedish meatballs are great and their desserts aren't bad either.

I just wish the carts turned when you tell them to turn. I always do this awkward side-walk type of movement when navigating the maze-like walkways.

Spent $10,000 on new kitchen and 9 weeks, 4 visits, hours of being on hold, multiple calls later, we are still without a kitchen and just have a ton of boxes taking up our entire living room. 

Expect to spend hours waiting around because people here move like sloths.

Totally recommend this place as a lunch spot. The prices are unbelievable. Great value for reasonably good food. Love the Swedish meatballs. Also have tried the salmon burger. This is also the perfect place to bring kids. Cheap kids meals, a daycare center while you shop, a beautiful kids furniture&toys section. It's awesome! 

As to the quality of their products, I've always been satisfied with my ikea furniture. Got a great desk and it's held up nicely with time. Same for my tv stand. Obviously, for the low prices, you can't expect perfection. But it's definitely great value. 

And... the staff at ikea are always pleasant and helpful at this location. Absolutely would recommend!

Overall, this is a great store. I've had some helpful staff and found some great furniture and treasures.  A few things that fall apart here are long lines at the cafeteria and long lines at the checkout. And BEWARE of plants, we brought home knats that took forever to eliminate.  We will continue to buy other furniture, dishes, and other items at this location.

Cafeteria type food that is just that. Nothing more or less. It was cheap and nothing great. I guess if you are in there shopping and get hungry try it. I wouldn't go there unless I happen to be in there and hungry.

Only need $2 breakfast, have a variety of options for lunch, the price is not expensive, but not very good, registered members drink is free of charge.Every time I shopping, children on the playground, my son likes ice cream and a hot dog when he came out in the playground

This store has the worst customer service I've ever experienced from Ikea. I've had three issues in two weeks, and will not be returning to this location. First, a click and collect order was not even processed and when I showed up towards the end of the window promised, was told I had to wait "15-20 minutes." This was 10 minutes before their 9pm closing. It was 9:45 before my order was ready, minus one item. I was so irritated that I didn't realize they also failed to give me the promised $5 gift card. Second bigger issue was being lied to about delivery of a sofa I had to order in store after calling customer service. Despite the website showing the sofa was available for online delivery and click and collect, I coukd not complete either. After calling and waiting on hold an hour, I was told the only way to purchase the sofa was through a store. So I so that, and tell the sales person Terrence H that I already have a furniture delivery scheduled and asked if this could be added to it. He says that because it's coming from the warehouse it can't be added, but I'll get two separate orders that day. So I get two confirmation calls from Ikea, and expect two separate deliveries. After receiving the earlier order and waiting through the end of the delivery window, I check the receipt and see the deliver is scheduled for the following week. Not only was I blatantly lied to, but I also scheduled a Task rabbit appointment for assembly. After taking an hour to get through the customer service line, then waiting on hold another hour I'm finally connected to an agent, explain this story, and she says she'll get the store manager on the line after holding again. The manager gets on the line, and I can't hear what he's saying. I wait until he's done speaking and state this at which point the call is disconnected. I call back, and as I'm writing this I've been on hold another hour and 15 minutes. The whole time listening to this message stating how easy Ikea makes shopping. I've been shopping with Ikea for decades, never experiencing this crappy customer service. I certainly won't ever shop at the South Philly store again, and time will tell if this is all bad luck or a true fall in Ikea's values.
Best food around at a great price!  Salmon dinner with veggies 6.50. Great deal supper healthy food.  Kids meals are 2.50.  Feed your family for under 20 bucks

The store is advertised here as opening at 9:30am.  I had to pick up an order this morning I had pre-ordered so I could pick it up and not be late for work.  Apparently only the restaurant is open at 9:30.  It doesn't say that in the hours on Apple maps / Yelp.  Now I have to wait here for a half hour until this place actually opens at 10am.  I have my son with me.  I have to get him to school still, now both he and I will definitely be late.  I haven't even gotten to receiving my order yet which I am sure will be a disaster if my experience so far is any indication.  This sort of misinformation is not acceptable and doesn't make any sense.

I went to IKEA for the first time 2 weeks before I moved into my apartment & it was all fun and games until I got to the warehouse. 
The staff were not friendly towards us at all. A man straight up told my sister and I no when we asked for assistance (were both a little over 100lbs) and not only that but were rude to us when we tried to get any type of direction in finding our items. A stranger actually saw we needed help and walked us through the whole experience. A STRANGER as the warehouse guys stood and chit chatted in a circle amongst themselves. We finally checked out and went to register for a delivery to the apartment on our move out date and the employee bluntly warned us that the movers were slackers and to watch out... like what?? & to top it all off they forgot 2 pieces to my bed frame which I'm still trying to put together myself (because no one gave me the option of having an expert set it up which I guess is a thing??) & I had to re purchase the 2 missing pieces elsewhere because every time I call the IKEA store the phones are busy or get put on hold for 63 minutes. So fuck you, IKEA.

Ikea is a great store to get new ideas.  A lot of it is nice quality and some of it looks cheap.  I highly recommend that you visit the store before you go to expensive showroom stores.  The prices are very good and spending hundreds more for something similar doesn't make sense to me.  My wife, son and I also ate in their cafe.  They had the chicken Swedish meatballs with mashed potatoes and lingonberry dressing.  They also got deserts (Swedish almond cake, and the Daim torte) and I was told they were really good.   My wife said the almond cake was very chocolaty.  I am on a diet.  They don't have any good options besides a boring salad with a little feta on it.  After we checked out, I found out that don't offer lite or fat-free dressing options.  They have Ranch, Caesar and French dressings.  We did get coffee (delicious) and frozen drinks after we checked out.  The lingonberry carbonated frozen drink was amazing and cheap ($1).  We will be back but I will eat before we get there.

Huge! Selection was great, friendly staff.  I'm giving this place five stars because I like mazes!!   Bring your family and go play hide and seek here!! Even if you don't buy anything, it'll be a blast!!  They'll never find you- and it will give you time alone to make a peaceful phone call or catch up on emails !

I had 2 interactions with customer service today.  The first was wonderful.  The second was the worst Ive been treated in an Ikea ever.  I've shopped for 17 years at 6 differerent ikea stores - from California to Singapore.  After an hour and a half drive to your store this morning to arrive at 10 - I returned a bath mirror.  This return was nice.  She was helpful and kind.  I drove home in the rain to my waiting hired contractors - to open the new box and find my mirrors broken.  So - I had to drive back - in the rain - to exchange a broken product / only to be put down and belittled because I didn't know the IKEA vocabulary.  After being put in my place - curtly - there was no understanding for my 3 hour day so far dealing with ikea - nor empathy.  This woman gave me such a terrible attitude - it made me feel rotten that the one of the newest stores in your chain has such up yours / who cares about you / attitude.  I'd rather order from your catalog than deal with your Indiana store again. So much for Hoosier hospitality.  Uppity know it all that really doesn't care is a better term for this store.

My wife's family has purchased almost $5,000 worth of furniture for their new house. The delivery company they use has lost pieces and will not assist in finding them. We call ikea and speak to a person on the phone and we end up waiting on the phone listening to their adds for over an hour so far. We don't even know why we are waiting. How long does it take for ikea to admit a mistake was made and to assist in fixing the issues????i don't recommend ever buying anything from ikea.
We were going to Ikea couple times a year. Sometimes to look for things, sometimes just to eat. The food is not bad with a good price. They have free wifi too

Such a shame that as a first time customer - I felt so unappreciated as a customer. When my order became lost in transit - no one could help me. I was transferred at least 10 times for a total hold time of over 90 minutes. Worst part is - nothing was resolved!  I was instead met with a terrible attitude from one customer service agent who laughed when I told her I needed a manager. And another who told me there was nothing they could do. I will definitely not be shopping here for anything in the future - and after reading all of the online reviews - this is clearly a pattern. I will instead work with companies that hire knowledgeable employees that are trained to value customers.  (Now who knows if/when I'll receive my kitchen delivery as no one knows!  Lol!)

I love the brand and have shopped at dozens of Ikea's in different countries, but this Ikea has a list of things wrong with it. So much so that shopping here has sadly lost its luster for me and my family. Here are the problems:

1. It doesn't matter how few or how many people are shopping, the lines are the slowest and worst I've ever seen, see photo.

2. You have to go through the whole store to get to/from the restaurant. And then the line is always crowded and slow. I did read that when Ikea's folks came to build in Indiana, they wanted to make midwesterners exercise for their food. It sadly ends up being impossible for work meals.

3. If you want to buy something from the Swedish food market, you have to go through the line for the bistro, unlike other locations where there is a separate place to buy food from the market. On crowded days, it can take an hour just to buy from the market.
4. There are no restrictions on shopping carts in the showcase area, making getting around the store very difficult. 

5. The store is clearly understaffed, even in summer when college students could rock.


The showrooms are adorable. Pity that shopping here is such a hassle. I'm going to keep going to the Cincinnati and Chicago locations, but my love of the Ikea experience is probably forever gone.

I've been told for years to visit Ikea, for the meatballs and home items. Finally I've had the chance to try out the Swedish entrees and peruse the options. I got the classic meatball entree, which has veggies, jam, and potatoes that come with it. There is so much seating, and it's cafeteria style, self serve just like the rest of the store! I like that mentality, just DIY and figure it out as you go. Meatballs are hot, and I wasn't sold on the jam until I tried it and loved it!! Just add some salt and the meatballs are tender and not overly cooked. 

There are some great deals, and walking through, you're left to pick out what you like and move
around, no one pestering you about what you need help with or what you're looking for. Their marketing is in there set up: The longer that people feel comfortable in the store and curious about their furniture and goods, the more time they have to talk themselves into bringing it home with them. Drop the kids off at the door and spend, people! I come for the cheap cheap plates and kitchen supplies.

Ordering from Ikea Online is a nightmare. If you must order an Ikea product, go to the store and only take what they have in stock.

Our nightmare began when we received an email saying our delivery was canceled. Then we find out it was a poorly worded email and it was only to be rescheduled. Then two #1 boxes showed up, and the Kallax Shelf Unit is supposed to come with two different boxes. Then an Ikea rep lied to us and said he'd Fedex the correct box. We wait a week to find out Ikea won't Fedex large items, and had to wait another 10 days for redelivery.

Ikea rep tells us whoever delivers the new one will pick up the old one, however we have to break down the part from box 1 we already built because instead of just bringing us one box #2, they have to deliver both boxes again and we have to return the originals.

Courier HCI delivery shows up and they don't have an order to pick up the original. Get on phone with supervisor and there is much bureaucratic red tape, where Courier HCI doesn't even talk with Ikea, they speak to another 3rd party, so they refuse to pick up the boxes. So now we have to schedule another 4 hour window for Ikea to pick up the boxes.

Trust me, you don't want this nightmare. Most times my wife an I called in, we'd either not get through or be placed on hold for 40 mins and get a totally useless rep. It's not worth it just for the Kallax Shelf Unit or any other Ikea products. Try Wayfair (which we had a great experience with, 2 deliveries actually came early) or elsewhere.

This is the best furniture and home decor shopping experience I've ever had. My review is honestly going to be very simple: They offer amazing prices. High quality products. And awesome customer service. That's it, they literally hit it on the head in all regards. I love IKEA!

I really liked shopping at Ikea in Fishers and have bought many items over the last few months since moving to Indy.  But the true mark of a store is its customer service when there is a problem.  I purchased a sofa and chair with delivery set for the next day (Fri) from 5 to 9pm.  Great! I had no problem with several deliveries before.  When I called to reschedule delivery early Fri morning to an earlier time I was told that the logistics of delivery was set and I could not change to an earlier time.  So I waited and waited for delivery until 9 pm and nothing came.  I called the delivery company just before 9 pm but was put on indefinite hold and was constantly told there was high call volume and I was number 4 in the queue even after 20 minutes of waiting.  So first thing the next morning on Saturday I again called the delivery company who now stated that status was delivered and signed for.  Telling the delivery customer service person that I never received delivery I was then told the driver finished his deliveries at 3pm and then fell asleep waiting for 5pm to make my delivery.  They would redeliver sometime after 1pm Sat.  I called Ikea store Customer Service twice to let them know about their delivery service, but after waiting over 15 mins on the phone each time I finally hung up.  So the bottom line is after you buy an item at Ikea expect no customer service.

The furniture selection is great! We bought everything we needed for our living room. The dinning area set up and service could be improved. Only one register open out of four with a very long line. People getting lost an old women ended up back in the kitchen area. They couldn't give us straws for drinks etc. The food was good we had chicken fingers and a slice of pie. Over all a good experience but the food area needs some better management for traffic flow and help.
Terrible customer service. On hold on phone 72 minutes and then informed was not scheduled for delivery even though receipt indicated scheduled and paid for the delivery

I waited nearly an hour to schedule a delivery after check-out - the area is so understaffed - not the front-line workers' fault, but mgt. for under-staffing.   Then, IKEA did not have the items ready for pick-up last night for the delivery company, which delays delivery and is a major inconvenience....nothing is worth all this trouble or hassle just to buy a few pieces of furniture...

Okay so this was my first time to this store. I have been to several other Ikea's. This was a disappointing trip. It may be because they haven't been open very long less than a year. We went in search of items we have bought at the West Chester Ohio store. It turns out they had neither one of them in the store but okay I had other things on my list. I purchased a lamp we already have it put together and it is working out nicely. I also purchased a small cabinet that I need to put together yet. 
My mom found some spice containers in one of the kitchen displays that she liked and we went down to the floor where they were and the row where where they should have been was completely empty. An item that I wanted to get we could not find but I found something that could have worked in its place but I could not reach it it was so high up and there was none in the lower racks and there was no employees to ask anywhere. 
I said I bought a cabinet it was extremely heavy and I needed help loading it on my truck. Usually there are two or three people outside of the West Chester store to help load but at this store there was no one at all. I got another customer to help me load it on my truck. 
The reason this garnered three stars is because it's still had all of the things that you look for in an Ikea store such as selection and the individual rooms made into kitchens  living rooms, bedrooms, etc.

Smaller than some IKEA stores, which is good and bad. It's a lot easier and quicker to navigate than some, but their showroom is smaller so less visible selection. Personally, I'm a huge fan of IKEA, and the four star rating is just because there is always something crucial to the room I'm putting together that they are out of stock on.

We have waited years for this paradise to open in our corner of the world!!
Such a fun place to wander, deals to be had! Plus a pretty good ice cream cone for $1

Where is the manager of this place?  After spending 2.5 hours walking the miles and miles of aisles, drinking in all the cool, weird, wonky, beautiful and useful items, I finally reached the finish line.  Line being the operative word, here.  There were 3 lines open, two right next to each other and the 3rd one about 12 cashier booths to the left.  Everything else was unmanned.  Each line had at least 16 people waiting, some with gigundo carts overflowing with God knows what, but it was going to be a lengthy time when they hit the checkout counter.  So... reluctantly I look at my cart, look at the lines, look at the cart, look at the lines and decided I could live without everything in the cart so I just pushed it out of the way and walked out the door.  Too bad, Ikea.  I like your stuff but I'm not waiting 45 minutes for the pleasure of paying.  Get your act together.  To shop there is exhausting and nobody wants to wait another 45 minutes in a line to get themselves out the door.  Management is asleep at the wheel if they can't figure that one out. Cashiers should be calling for more help when there are 3 or more people in a line if the store wants people to actually walk out the door with a purchase and not ditch it like I did.

This is one of those "go for the experience" kind of places. And once you've been it's that "go for one thing or go for 5 hours" kind of places. 
Because they have E V E R Y T H I N G. 
Recommendations:
Take a map. For real. Because the "yellow shirts" can be hard to find at times. 
Have a plan. Unless it's your first time and you're "just looking" go in for your specific item and try to get out before you're remodeling your kitchen. 
Download the app. While the connectivity can be a bit spotty, the app allows you to easily find specific items and you can make a list ahead of time. 
Eat there. For real, the food is delish and relatively healthy depending on your choices. 
Join IKEA family. It's free and you get some great perks, including extra time for child care, (because they have that-and please use it, people with children, because...well read my recs) free coffee or tea, and additional sale prices. 
It's seriously the best and this location is ridiculously convenient with the I69 upgrades. Make a day and check out IKEA.

The vast majority of my furniture has come from ikea. I have owned many pieces for years and they are still holding up. Obviously I'm a fan so of course I went back when looking for a new couch. For the first time though I was having it delivered. I have read horror stories about XPO, the company that ikea contracts for delivery. Thankfully my experience was positive. They arrived right on time, were respectful and all of the pieces were included and intact. Thanks again Ikea!

Honestly, after walking for a long time at this store I feel I should NOT have to wait at least another 40 minutes to pay for my items.  Slowest lines ever.  Very inefficient.  Why don't you have a line for people with less items?  Also, NEVER order online with Ikea.  Never.  HORRIBLE HORRIBLE HORRIBLE customer service.  They don't honor their delivery date from the email, the number they give to call for customer service on their email and online is WRONG.  Horrible customer service.  HORRIBLE.  Avoid this store.   Horrible cashier, horrible managers, horrible everything.  Wish I could give NEGATIVE STARS.  I WILL NEVER RETURN TO THIS STORE AT ALL.  

UPDATE AND WARNING: As I'm waiting in line ALREADY fed up with the long wait, to pay AND writing this review (because I have nothing better to do in all the time you kept me waiting BUT to write a negative review) things got EVEN WORSE (Is it possible?!?). This man at another line near to us CUTS in front of the people who have also been waiting a long time and this lady in line starts to complain telling them to get off the line and to call the manager.  They allow the guy to cut in line saying it's inevitable and blah blah because he needs to fix a problem at THAT line AND they call security on the lady who was NOT insulting anyone but complaining as she should AND AS I WOULD HAVE and security tells HER to calm down (!) when she is complaining about the people cutting in line.  I felt bad for her because they threatened to escort HER out which was UNFAIR and they did not because she rightly told them that never in history has telling someone to calm down when they are upset has it worked.   She did not insult you and she was rightly upset.  GET SOME TRAINING IKEA!!! HORRIBLE security people, HORRIBLE manager, HORRIBLE cashier.  Never coming back EVER and you should avoid this store too.  The cheap prices are NOT worth the stress.  Not only did I have to put up with the stress of waiting in line BUT ALSO had to watch someone cut in line in front of another person (You're LUCKY they didn't cut in front of me!) and had to watch the security thugs BULLY the lady WHO WAS RIGHT.  Did security NOT hear the other customers also grumbling about how THEY were behaving and how that lady WAS RIGHT? They should be FIRED!  SO aggravating!  This store AND their online "customer service" must be reflective of the brand's TOTAL lack of respect for customers.  YOU LOST A CUSTOMER WHO HAD SPENT HUNDREDS OF DOLLARS IN YOUR STORE AND I'M SPREADING THE WORD.  I don't need this crap on a Saturday and neither do you.

Always enjoy Ikea's meals and will definitely have a meal there when we drop by! In particular, the meatballs and salmon are tasty and light, that comes with vegetables, a healthy meal! 

There's an option to get a kids meal which is generous in portion and quite worthwhile. Alternatively, we sometimes get a few kids meal so that we can enjoy different things. Like a mini buffet.

Ikea family card holders also get a free coffee.

The cafeteria is nice, however, anyone with tastebuds can tell you that all of it was quite bland. Everything lacked taste and spices. My friends and I went there for a quick bite when it first opened up, and all the dishes we received, we didn't end up finishing because it lacked flavor. IKEA is a furniture store and it should remain only that.

First visit here did not disappoint! The store is organized and clean. If it's your first time, I suggest grabbing a map at the front and maybe even inquire how the store works from a friendly associate. Be aware: Saturdays are hecticccc. Arrive early to grab a good parking spot!
Pretty decent value for the furniture that you are able to get. Just have to build it yourself

Mostly just reviewing the cafeteria here.     I finally got the meatballs after hearing about them for years and years and years...   Its pretty much hospital food but with a little more flair.    The price is right.    Nothing I'd go out of my way for.

The store itself is full of contemporary furniture and decor which is  probably a great match for an urban apartment - not so much for a suburban house.    They specialize in maximizing space efficiency - kinda the opposite of Restoration Hardware that sells furniture for Paul Bunyan's house.

I'm not a fan of the "walk through our entire store" because I generally know exactly what I want. Also, staff literally didn't interact with me until I rushed after a guy to ask if they had my dresser in stock. The stuff is cheaper than most stores and I assume all in Swedish, except for the directions, which are just photos. Most people spend hours In the store. I don't think this store is extraordinary for any ikea or rather bad. It's just Eh.

Ikea has been nothing but trouble. Do not order online, as they'll deliver with missing pieces and then you'll be totally stuck. So now you go to the Ikea to get those missing pieces, they tell you "online and in store ikeas are totally separate entities" so that means they don't have the pieces you need in stock. 

So then they sell you another piece that will fit but is more expensive that you have to buy at full price, and send you on your way to deal with the online ikea yourself. The online ikea doesn't answer the phone, it literally hangs up on you because every time you call they have "higher than normal call volume". Terrible company, terrible customer service, would not recommend getting your furniture here.

I have been to IKEA in 4 other states. I've always received excellent service, was able to purchase exactly what I came for and was happy with my experiences. Not so at the Tampa IKEA. Rating it against itself or for that matter any other retail store it is THE WORST! Grossly understaffed, steeped in policies that make no sense, and completely unapologetic about it. I'd give them NO stars if it were possible. I spent over $1000 on a closet system which had already been planned out and set up in their own system so it should have been a slam dunk in and out buy - instead it took 3 hours and even then I had an email waiting for me when I arrived home telling me crucial pieces are not in stock so they'll refund that portion and send out the rest  as ordered 2 weeks from now. Do they not restock in that period of time!? Awful just terrible.

Holy anxiety! My husband and I decided to stop on our way back to the south side to see what all the hype was about. I literally thought I was in a fun house! You start on one side and it's set up like "rooms" so you get ideas and see how it's look in your house. Ok, that's cool for the first 5 but after that it gets a tad overwhelming. 

It's separated in areas like office, kitchen, bedroom, etc with little decor pieces sprinkled here and there but not much considering everyone is aimlessly walking around pushing large empty carts which clog up the aisle ways. Once you venture in, there's no clear way on how to get out unless you turn around and go back the way you came or keep pushing through! About halfway though (I think?) I turned to my husband and said "ok I'm done, can you get us out of here?" (This is the part my anxiety started sinking in). After locating a hanging "you are here" sign and realizing we were in a "sub category" and had to maneuver back to the main path we got a little disoriented and thought we'd never make it out! 

Employees are very few and far between so you can't find anyone to ask questions or assistance so you have to fend for yourself. Luckily we found our way to the registers which are on the opposite side of course and were able to get out alive! 

We still aren't quite sure what all the hype is about but left with all the money we took in so I think that's a plus? Oh and we didn't have to camp out over night or attack someone for their complementary meatball so that's good too! 

We don't see a second IKEA run in our future though and heavily advise you "enter at your own risk!"

DO NOT BUY FROM IKEA!!!! This business is a clown show. Just moved from downsizing a few times throughout the USA  and we thought "let's get some Ikea stuff" to help furnish our new house that had much more space. HUGE MISTAKE. Ordered a bed. Looked at a few couches but no one would help us. We were going to use IKEA to fill our whole house. Been a month and still haven't even gotten the bed. Missed 3 delivery days with not even a call. We had to call. Still not here. Now I have been on customer service waiting for 75 minutes with no end in sight so I felt the need to let potential buyers know to go somewhere else without a second thought.

Take stuff home, but do not attempt to get home delivery!  Customer service is non-existent.  The phone number is useless, as a message says "all circuits are busy" whenever you call.  Emails either don't go through or go unanswered.  When we had problems getting our furniture delivered on time, the only way to straighten it out was to go to a physical store and speak with a person, who then gave us the correct number to call, as our pieces were being delivered out of state.  They are unreachable.  Do not attempt home delivery!!!!
When coffee was medium warm it tasted like peanuts with half of the skin on. If you go to the top cafeteria the coffee is on par.

It is  a fun experience! Very good for first starter houses to be furnished from A-to-Z. The instructions can be a little troublesome but overall I like the assortment and prices of the items they display.
I do enjoy the cafeteria because the prices are good and the food is good as well. I still tend to get lost in the store because it's so enormous. No I learned just to go to the marketplace first instead of roaming around for the other areas. I've used IKEA for my college kids dorms and rental homes. 
Oh!And the seasonal items are very fun.

We had a great experience at this location a few weeks ago. 

(1) smallland checkin for my son was easy, safe, clean,...and he had a great time with a group of about 8 other kids.

(2) they had all the bedding, lighting, and sand toys we wanted  in stock and we were able to find everything pretty easily and quickly

(3) check out was smooth

(4) we loaded our stuff in the car, then picked up our son and took both kids for a snack in the cafe with our free IKEA family coffee. For about $6 they both had a late lunch and I had a decent (machine) cappuccino.

WORST CUSTOMER SERVICE. I am so incredibly disappointed with Ikeas customer support! I have called now 3 times trying to get information on my case. I called last week because I needed a new top for my Hemnes dresser because the one i purchased in store was damaged. After staying on hold for 45 mins a woman picked up and dealt with my case. She provided me with a case number and explained that my top for my dresser would be on its way! I never got an email with a tracking number and have not heard back from Ikea. No word where my dresser top is, or if I will be receiving it. Now it has been weeks without my dresser for my bedroom and my clothes have been just sitting on the floor. Completely unacceptable. I am even typing this as I wait on hold for the third time trying to figure out the progress of my dresser. Everyone who answers keep throwing me around to different departments and have no idea why my shipment has not gone out yet. I have been on hold for about an hour and a half now. I am extremely disappointed I even wasted my time purchases furniture from you when I could have gone to target and had a completely different and Professional experience. I feel like I am being hassled and I still have not relieved the full product that I have purchased. This is not how you do business. This has been the worst waste of time for me. I will be writing reviews and giving feedback on my experience until this is handled...... Again, very disappointed.

More on this IKEA saga! They called to move my delivery out further AND still not delivering the shelves that they removed from my order -tell me how useful is a closet WITHOUT SHELVES!? After I told the very nice service center gal what I had endured so far including waitng over 30 mins. for her in order to find out WTH! she put me through to online sales. Of course they answered right away. I was able to order those same shelves; but get this NOT pay for them (which means their delivery date is pure BS) until I get online and do it myself. Well if I was in a position to do that why would I call!? How totally stupid!  I used to love IKEA not anymore!

The Ikea Bistro is the best kept secret and place to get Swedish food in Tampa while also offering an amazing value! I have come here many times just for the Swedish meatballs because they are so tasty and only $4! I also like coming here for the Swedish breakfast which includes Swedish pancakes (crepes), eggs, potatoes, and sausage and only costs $2! The eggs came out amazing fluffy and tasty surprisingly! If you're an Ikea family member you can get tasty complimentary coffee including mocha-chinos, cappuccinos, and lattes. There's something about the Swedish style milk they have that is just sweater and tastier than the American milk that really compliments the coffees and brings the coffee there to another level ! I look forward to coming here again soon for some meatballs or for breakfast !

Worst customer service I have ever received. We ordered a bed for our son, paid $118 for delivery and assembly. THREE WEEKS LATER....we have not received our bed. They have promised to deliver the bed four separate times and have either cancelled or never showed up. Want to call customer service? Expect to be on hold at least 45 minutes.

All the money that this store makes, you think that they could hire enough staff to run the registers and fix the wheels on their carts. I only give it a two stars because of the unique items in the store.

It has taken me this long to review this place as I've been so angry for the past month.  On New Year's Day, I visited this Ikea (first time at this one and last time) with my friend.  Needless to say, we visited the restaurant and one of the workers there was so rude, I actually thought I was on candid camera and any moment someone would approach me and say "we're just kidding."  No, it actually happened.  This young person, Sean, was the rudest and when I asked to speak to the manager, what happened next can not be made up.  The manager (who refers to herself as the "buck stops here") listened to me patiently and afterwards, she turned just as fast when I asked her for the contact information to go above her.  I merely asked her this because I was so taken back by how Sean spoke to me, that I couldn't believe anyone would take me seriously and I thought if I asked to speak to someone higher up in the chain, she'd know i was serious.  Needless to say, I've left out alot of details because still today, when I think about that day....I still can't believe that anyone would have hired someone like Sean, much less, the manager.  Unfortunately, those two may still be employed by this IKEA, but I certainly have not returned since this time...and don't ever plan to return.  The products are not worth the treatment you are subjected to.
It took me 2 hours to walk through... TWO HOURS! Though I enjoyed my excursion, I'll need a scooter the next time I go.

Dear Ikea,

Congratulations on being 2018's recipient of Nathan's Slice of Poo award. Each year, this rare reward is given to the one entity that has provided the worst service/experience during the past 12 months. Your online service has been so exceptionally bad, I've decided to reward it to you 6 months before the actual end of the year.

This review is for the corporate office for the online website, and this is the Yelp page for the closest store to the headquarters.

It's not me or the scores of people complaining every day about your non-existent customer support. It's you. There are mountains of complaints on your FB page during the past year, and you're pretty much ignoring them.

For 9 hours, I haven't been able to reach you on your customer support line, your email, your twitter, your non-existent chat, or your FB page at all. Your website says replies within 48-72 hours (which is already unacceptable for an online shopping site), though others on Reddit and FB report not hearing back in weeks, which is just unbelievable. We're being ghosted. By the time your phone line was working, there was a reported 120 minute wait but only 60 minutes left on the support line before it closed for the day. You've been doing this every day. That's a scam.

How does a large corporation like you even get away with not having any customer support?

If you want to ghost your customers this badly, then you can continue being dead to us.

Update: It only took 20 phone calls (I gave up after 3 days), 5 emails, and 80 hours of waiting before I finally reached someone. It wasn't someone in customer support (it's impossible to reach anyone there) but someone in tech support (I guess that means tech support ticket queue isn't weeks/months long). Apparently, they're aware their whole online system is trash, so they're scrapping and replacing it. Unfortunately, they're still months away from the new online system, so everyone's stuck in customer support hell. That's just not acceptable.

WORST CUSTOMER SERVICE IN THE KNOWN UNIVERSE!

I recently ordered furniture for my office from Ikea.com.  What followed was the WORST customer service experience of my entire life.  First of all.  They wanted me to pay for delivery that was going to take more than 3 weeks.  In the digital age that is bad enough, but when the order finally did arrive it was incomplete.  The driver tried 3 times to get me to sign for the entire order when he delivered less than half of the boxes that he was supposed to deliver.  He also told me that I would have to call in to talk to someone from customer service to get the rest of the order sent out - it was not automatic.  That call took almost 4 hours!!!  I was put on hold repeatedly, called a liar, hung up on, lied to and forced to listen to hours of hold messages telling me how great Ikea is and how much they care about me.  Finally they admitted that they messed up and would send out a replacement.  There was only one problem....IT WAS GOING TO BE ANOTHER 10 DAYS!!!  I told them the wait time was unacceptable and they assured me that they would expedite the process.  After a week of hearing nothing I called back and once again sat on hold for hours waiting to get help only to be told that there was nothing they could do and that it might actually be longer than 10 days to fix the issue.  When the second order finally came, guess what?  IT WAS INCOMPLETE AGAIN!!!  Once again I sat for hours on hold only to be told that once again they couldn't help me - wouldn't refund my money and I would have to wait again for yet another order.  I'm done with them.  I'm just gonna file a fraud claim with my credit card company and let them deal with it.  Ikea has great products at good prices, but what good does that do you when they take your money and don't deliver on their promises and respond with THE WORST CUSTOMER SERVICE IN THE KNOWN UNIVERSE.

I have only been to an Ikea store once before and it was many years ago. Our experience couldn't have been better. We were in and out with a mattress and dresser in less than 15 minutes. The organization of the store is 10 out of 10. I'm sure we will be shopping here more frequently.

My husband and I drove over a hour to IKEA to purchase a bed for our daughter (as a surprise) on a Tuesday afternoon. We wanted the bed up before she came home that following Monday. We picked the bed out and waited for customer service to tell us what to do next. 

When we finally got someone's attention, (that was about a 10 minute wait) we walked over to this area where you get your boxes (which was another story) and then we went to pay for it. 

Once paid, we had to go to another area to have the bed delivered. The lady tells us that our bed will be delivered Saturday from 9am to 9pm... THAT'S RIGHT...A 12 HOUR WINDOW!!! Worst then any cable/internet service connection window I've ever heard. 

So Saturday these people NEVER SHOWED UP!!! We sat around all day waiting for that bed. We called. They placed us on hold. Then said sorry... we're closed......  Are you kidding me?!?! Needless to say we were hot!

The next morning we called and the excuses came. From it was the delivery company's fault, to it must have happened at the store. Once they stop with all the excuses, our daughter was home with only mattresses and no bed. The bed wasn't delivered until Thursday afternoon. 5 DAYS AFTER THE ORIGINAL DELIVERY DAY!!! They could have at least waived the delivery charge for our inconvenience.

Needless to say.... it will be the last time we do business with them.

OH!!! The reason why I'm giving them 2 stars instead of 1 star is because...it really is a really nice bed.
IKEA-HACKING FTW. Plus meatballs & lingonberry soda for energy. Flat-pack furniture, cheap hotdogs, do I really need to tell you about IKEA?

More on this IKEA saga! They called to move my delivery out further AND still not delivering the shelves that they removed from my order -tell me how useful is a closet WITHOUT SHELVES!? After I told the very nice service center gal what I had endured so far including waitng over 30 mins. for her in order to find out WTH! she put me through to online sales. Of course they answered right away. I was able to order those same shelves; but get this NOT pay for them (which means their delivery date is pure BS) until I get online and do it myself. Well if I was in a position to do that why would I call!? How totally stupid!  I used to love IKEA not anymore!

Phase 3 of the never ending IKEA saga. So During my very UNPLEASANT store visit (see first part of the IKEA saga) I paid for delivery AND assembly which as you'll note in phase 2 they changed both contents AND date. The XPO guys arrive and they're only delivery guys - no knowledge or tools to do the assembly. I had them bring it all in and I refused to sign for it till I spoke to a supervisor and demanded a date and time of assembly within 2 days since they could clearly see it was paid for (sent them a text photo of my receipt). They tried very hard to get out but I had them call their office on THEIR phone  so they couldn't leave till I was satisfied that I had everything scheduled. I spoke with Gary, as Kailyn who was on the phone at first had no power to do anything. Her advice call IKEA. OH HELL NO!! Not letting XPO out till I had a crew scheduled. 
With that accomplished I have been trying to get through to IKEA since! Of course still not successful. So I'm quite sure there'll be even more nonsense.
I've seen reviews of the XPO delivery service and they're not good. I can't say I agree they are being set up to FAIL BY IKEA!! The guys who arrived were very nice, respectful, and eager to help but not trained or equipped to assemble and IKEA had not asked them to even though they were paid in advance. If I could give IKEA NEGATIVE stars that's what they'd get. Tampa IKEA has ruined IKEA for me and I will never go back.
Forced to wait at furniture pickup for over an hour. It appears no one is doing anything to expedite even though I asked about my pick up. Extremely poor customer service.

Who doesn't love furniture that you put together without instructions that make sense? This is why they offer the ball pit and meatballs! You are purchasing things while Swedish meatball drink!

This location is no less zany or crowded than others.

New to the area. Visited this ikea several times for various things. We have always had a good experience, staff is very helpful. We have had orders delievered and communication has been fine. For reference, we have had a closet system, bookshelves and shoe organizers delivered in two different orders/deliveries. Can't complain.

OMG! You could not pay me enough money to ever come to this place again! Rude employees, lousy selection, horrible parking. Seriously? People actually go here? Don't know what I was thinking. Stay away...

My favorite store - period. I can always something cool for any little need I have. Their products are smart and versatile. And the cafeteria is delicious and reasonably priced. Customer Service is friendly and returns and exchanges have been hassle free for me.
You know, I like the store and they have cute, stylish things, but I have returned 2 items since they opened and their return system stinks! Makes me reluctant to purchase from there!

Honestly such a smart business move! This store has everything you need in a home. Kitchen, bedroom, bathroom, living, outside, and more! Not only do they provide all the furniture you could ever possibly need, but they provide an experience as well! As I walked through showroom after showroom, I found myself feeling like a child... ooo'ing and ahh'ing at everything I saw. And to top it all off, you can't beat the prices for the quality of furniture. I've been nothing but pleased with each purchase I've made. Oh and it gets better, there's food here too! Cafeteria style and it's sooo good! Enjoy the fun IKEA has to offer! You won't be disappointed

I purchased clear bins online for pick up at the Ikea store near my condo in downtown Tampa. I never received a confirmation email informing me that the bins were ready for pick up. When I went to the store to pick up they informed me that the bins do not come with lids. I went back out to the sales floor to buy lids and none where available. The system shows 28 in stock so an associate looked for them and could not find. Since no lids were available I decided to return the bins and now I am holding a ticket #20 and they are working with customer #9. Beyond frustrated. Zero focus on the customer experience!!

I visited the store on 7/28/18 and placed an order and chose the delivery service. I was told that Friday, August 3rd, between 9am-9pm, was the earliest delivery date available, but if we came back to the store on 7/29/18 in the morning, Dave, the cashier at the home delivery service counter, assured that we could reschedule for next day delivery service because it is first come first serve and we would have a good shot of getting next day delivery if we came early. On 7/29/18 around 10am, my husband drove back to ikea to have the delivery date changed. At 10:40am, he was given a new delivery date of 7/30/18 between 1PM and 5PM. He asked for confirmation and the woman at the home delivery counter said she had our phone number and email on file and that was all she needed and we were good to go. She even wrote the new shipment date and time on our boxes that were to be delivered. Come 3PM on 7/30/18, after calling out of work and no delivery truck to be seen, I called Ikea to find out where our delivery was and they again confirmed 7/30/18 1-5pm time slot and were advised to call the delivery company. We called the delivery company just to be told that they were never informed of the delivery date change, and that it was still scheduled for Friday, August 3rd between 9am-9pm. After time wasted and losing out on money I could have been making if I went to work, I went back and forth with ikea customer service on the phone and never received a proper solution to the issue. I was on hold for OVER AN HOUR waiting to connect to the resolution center. Common theme here is WASTE OF TIME. I am extremely aggravated at how poorly customer service has treated the issue. This has been ridiculous and a complete waste of time and I refuse to give any more time or money to this company. Just reached out via email so hopefully they can address this issue. Such a shame because I didn't have an issue with the products, just the incompetence of the customer service we received.

I'm only rating this experience with 3 stars because like everyone else I got lost in this store. However, I only wished I had gone with a friend so that we could laugh about it. Since I didn't, I decided to take a break while I figured things out. During that break I tried a slice of the Daim cake in the cafeteria, and oh my word was it amazing! Once I successfully made it out of the maze of IKEA I immediately googled the recipe. 

I'm going back for the cake.

Came here on a Monday morning just as the cafeteria was opening. We sat down to eat when we noticed that the floor and tables around us were filthy. There was food all over the floor. We grabbed a high chair, which was also really dirty.  

We were literally the first people inside the cafeteria that morning  - shouldn't everything have been cleaned the night before or prior to opening? Shouldn't a cafeteria be cleaned daily, at minimum? I'm not a neat freak by any means, but I got grossed out by this experience.

Stopping by IKEA to buy some home furnishings means a stop by their bistro for some of their "famous" meatballs. I truly believe they're famous cause they don't serve anything else better...plus the meatballs stay somewhat moist even though they're sitting in a steam table all day long. 

On my recent visit this last weekend, I stopped by when I was starving and trust me, that's the worst time to go, but a good time since you don't need wait for some to assemble your food; it's right there for someone to scoop it up. 

3/5 Garlic Toast $0.69 was ok...a little dry and cold since it was probably sitting there for a while; they didn't have anything to keep it warm like a heating light. 

4/5 Meatballs $5.99 was the best thing on the menu and what I suggest ordering; it comes with 2 sides and I received mashed potatoes and steam vegetables. The saving grace is the gravy they used to coat the meatballs that keep them somewhat moist.

1/5 Beef Tenderloin $8.99 was a waste of money; beef was dry and hard on the edges. I needed to return it for another plate of meatballs and unfortunately I didn't get the difference back, but that's because the line to pay was long and I decided to forego it. 

3/5 Chocolate Cake $2.99 was decent; I've had much better but for a place that just prides itself on a dollar ice cream and soda, it was a bit high for the quality received. 

Overall friendly service and ok food if you're not that picky; definitely stay with the meatballs as nothing else there really moves.

If you're looking to improve your life and your environment, there aren't many places better than IKEA that allow you to do this at a reasonable price. 

In case you've never been, they carry everything from full on complete kitchens to a simple fork and knife and their prices are unbelievably inexpensive. I'll say this...some of the quality in some of their products are really cheap in terms of material make up, but they also have other options that are on the other side of the spectrum. Many of their furniture is modular so you can get different looks and it all just works together effortlessly. 

If you don't have a large vehicle to take the things with you, they also offer a delivery service, but the fun part isn't taking the things home with you...it's assembling them all together which I highly suggest reading the directions and getting it done the right way the first time! There's a reason for the way they tell you how to use specific pieces at certain steps, but me with my ADD always makes me jump ahead only to disassemble and fall back several steps, sometimes all the way to the beginning. 

Pro Tip...if you're stuck and can't take apart some of their furniture, youtube it and you'll find how to proceed; true story...some of their furniture looks simple to figure out but you could get stumped just trying to figure things out and in my case, youtube came to the rescue once again.

If you are thinking of using IKEA for your counter tops, stop right now and go somewhere else.  Dealing with them has been a terrible experience.   First the sales person lied to us about charges.  Second, The person who came out to do our template was rude and straight up sexist.  Third since getting the template we have been unable to contact anyone at IKEA or the contractor.  We have been fully charged but we have no idea if we and when we are getting our counter too.  When we call the phones are either down or we get shuffled from department to department with no one able to help or end up leaving vms that are never returned.

Clearly I will never shop with them again and will be sure to spread that message loud and clear.  IKEA should be embarrassed.

Dear IKEA,
It has been 2 1/2 months since my order was supposed to be delivered. I had to email the CEO before you would even respond to my issue. Now it has been 3 weeks since I spoke to him and you still have not resolved the issue. This is the worst service I have ever received and I want people to know how awful you are before they attempt to deal with your company. Please don't buy anything from IKEA! Don't waste your hard earned money or your time because you will eventually have to deal with their lack of communication and overall uncaring attitude toward their customers. Buy American.

Seriously one of the worst customer service experience of any IKEA location.  We travel quite a bit for work and while we've had our difficulties with dealing with IKEA, overall.  The employees are impossible to get in touch with, they never return phone calls and did not provide any sort of assistance to help make up for their failure to deliver their products on time.

Long story short, I placed an order for pickup over 24 hours in advance.  When I sent my drivers on a 3+ hour drive to pick up the order, nothing was ready for pickup at the scheduled time and then I got a call from IKEA, telling me that not only had they not pulled everything on time, but they wouldn't pull these items for me until the next day.  They refused to let me call a manager and weren't even able to tell me what items were unavailable.  They promised to let me know what was on the shelf and never called me back.

I have been to the following IKEA locations: Schaumburg (IL), Bolingbrook (IL), Westchester (OH), Toronto (Ontario), and this one. Of the five, Schaumburg is hands down the best. It is laid out better, and it seems to carry more items. The Fishers location is on par with Bolingbrook, tied for last place. The reason for this is the one-story layout, in which you have to walk through a bunch of showrooms before you can get to the part of the store that actually has product, and it is frustrating because all of the first-time shoppers tend to create a back-up of traffic while they stop in the aisles to look at the show room. Another obnoxious thing is the returns area: They have maybe one or two associates at registers to handle all of the returns, exchanges, and requests for spare parts that come through. This means that you will often find yourself waiting upwards of twenty minutes before your take-a-ticket number is called.
